description_en: Deletes the remediation settings of a specified account group rule
description_zh: 删除指定账号组规则的修正设置
kebab_example: aliyun config delete-aggregate-remediations --remediation-ids crr-909ba2d4716700eb0000 --aggregator-id ca-6b4a626622af00120000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAggregateRemediations

parameters.help_en: The remediation setting IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can call [ListAggregateRemediations](~~China~~) to obtain the IDs. If no remediation settings exist, call CreateAggregateConfigRule, ListRemediationTemplates (filter by ManagedRuleIdentifier), and CreateAggregateRemediation in sequence to create remediation settings, and then query the RemediationId
parameters.help_zh: 修正设置 ID。多个 ID 之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。可通过 ListAggregateRemediations 获取；如果尚无修正设置，依次调用 CreateAggregateConfigRule、ListRemediationTemplates（按 ManagedRuleIdentifier 过滤）和 CreateAggregateRemediation 创建后，再查询 RemediationId
parameters.name: remediation_ids

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

RemediationDeleteResults.description_en: The results of the delete remediation settings operation
RemediationDeleteResults.description_zh: 删除修正设置的操作结果

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error code.

If the remediation settings are deleted, this parameter is empty.

If the remediation settings fail to be deleted, this parameter displays the error code. For more information about error codes, see <props="china">Error Center (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)</props><props="intl">Error Center (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)</props>
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误码。

当您删除修正设置成功时，该参数为空。

当您删除修正设置失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见<props="china">错误中心 (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)</props><props="intl">错误中心 (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)</props>

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: Successful.

false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
